name: Verdades Incompletas
source:
You’ve died, and your three friends visit your home. One of them may have killed you. Investigate, explore each room, and listen as they reveal fragments of truth.

[From [url=https://eternodev.itch.io/verdades-incompletas]Itch.io[/url]]
